name: Dragonfly BMS
description: The Phaetus Dragonfly BMS (Bi-Metallic Standard) is a compact, lightweight all-metal hotend featuring a bi-metallic heatbreak for excellent thermal separation. Its small form factor and Dragon-style direct mount (M3 bolt pattern) make it popular for weight-sensitive toolhead designs like Voron builds. The bi-metallic heatbreak combines a stainless steel upper section with a copper lower section, allowing a sharper thermal gradient and better high-temperature performance than traditional all-metal heatbreaks. Heater cartridge and thermistor are sold separately.

thermalSpecs.thermistorType: not included (user-supplied, typically NTC 100K or PT1000)
